# Coding Bunker

Coding Bunker is an independent tech community in Milan for people who build software.

## Canonical pages

- https://www.codingbunker.it/
- https://www.codingbunker.it/en
- https://www.codingbunker.it/events
- https://www.codingbunker.it/partners
- https://www.codingbunker.it/press
- https://www.codingbunker.it/staff
- https://www.codingbunker.it/impatto-milano
- https://www.codingbunker.it/code-of-conduct

## Community actions

- Events and registration: https://www.meetup.com/it-IT/coding-bunker/
- Community photos: https://www.meetup.com/coding-bunker/photos/
- Submit a talk: https://sessionize.com/codingbunker/
- Partnership request: https://forms.gle/FPca5upst1VTGFP86
- Contact: mailto:info@codingbunker.it

## Short description

Coding Bunker organises free meetups, talks, open discussions and practical activities in Milan. The community values accessible technical knowledge, open collaboration and real-world experience.
